decisions.decision: The run is for a user who instructs an AI and leaves the AI to arrange the work, as the user answered 「ユーザーがAIに指示してAIが段取る」.
Once the limit lifts, the stopped work goes on from where it stopped, and a record remains of what stopped and what resumed, as the user answered 「１と２」.
The aim is that work moves on while the user sleeps and in the morning they only check the results, as the user answered 「１」.
The talk is in Japanese, the language of the user's words, and the deliverables are in English, the language of the repository's documents, so each reader reads their own.

questions: 最初に作るものはどれにしますか。1: 上限が解けたら、止まった作業が止まったところから自動で続く (推奨。issue #62 の望む状態そのもので、2 の記録も再開があってはじめて意味を持つため) 2: 朝、上限で止まったものと再開したものの記録が見られる
